method: Saved absolute speed profiles; subtract D0 from D14 within mouse at each identical spatial bin, then mean and SEM across mice. No added smoothing; finite paired bins only.
coordinate: Original camera x descending from1255 to35; distance=(1255-x)*700/1201. Entry-side profile boundary, not independently detected tape mark.
coverage: At least half group contributes to displayed bins; no bridging gaps. SEM is descriptive across mice, not cage-adjusted inference.
presentation: Trajectory axes replaced by 10 cm horizontal and 50 mm/s vertical scale bars, labelled zero-change line and dashed start/finish boundaries; scatter plot area 250 by 250 SVG units; ticks at -100,-50,0,50,100; mm label to left; statistical annotations omitted.
statistics: Statistical annotations hidden, saved results retained: cage-level change test, unadjusted omnibus and Holm within 3 pairs. No new spatial tests. Profile and scatter use saved spatial and whole-trial summaries respectively.
